//go:build sluis_test

// Regenerates actors/indexer/tests/testdata/go-writer/ from the merged writer, as it stands.
//
// This is a Go test of the writer's own package, kept here as text so that no other package's files change.
// To regenerate the fixture:
//
//   1. copy this file to actors/writer/internal/writerd/export_fixture_test.go;
//   2. from the repository root run
//        IDX_DUMP=<an empty directory> go test -tags sluis_test -run TestExportFixture -count=1 ./actors/writer/internal/writerd
//   3. copy <dir>/blob/audit to testdata/go-writer/audit, <dir>/vkey to testdata/go-writer/vkey and
//      <dir>/opened.json to testdata/go-writer/opened.json;
//   4. delete the copied test file.
//
// The test writes the log with the writer (40 messages, a batch of at most 10, tenants acme, globex and none),
// checks it with `sluis audit verify`, and records for each sealed entry what the writer's own key stand-in
// opens it to at its address. The key that sealed the entries is not kept: opened.json is the stand-in for key@
// in the indexer's test, and the entries stay sealed.

package writerd

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func TestExportFixture(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("IDX_DUMP")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("SKIP: IDX_DUMP is not set")
	}
	e := newEnv(t)
	e.cfg.BatchMax = 10
	em := emitterOf(t, e)
	e.start()
	const n = 40
	for i := range n {
		tenant := []string{"acme", "globex", ""}[i%3]
		action := []string{"key.sign", "store.start"}[i%2]
		e.push(newMessage(t, em, action, tenant))
	}
	wait(t, "all messages", func() bool { return e.tr.ackedCount() == n })
	_ = e.mustVerify(t)
	if err := exec.Command("cp", "-r", e.root, filepath.Join(out, "blob")).Run(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "vkey"), []byte(e.verifier()), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	type opened struct {
		Envelope, Tenant, Kind, ID, Plaintext string
	}
	var all []opened
	for _, en := range recordEntries(logEntries(t, e.logDir())) {
		md := en["metadata"].(map[string]any)
		sealed, _ := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(en["sealed"].(string))
		id := SealID("sluis", "audit", "main", md["uid"].(string))
		pt, err := e.key.open(sealed, md["tenant_uid"].(string), SealKind, id)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		all = append(all, opened{en["sealed"].(string), md["tenant_uid"].(string), SealKind, id, base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(pt)})
	}
	b, _ := json.Marshal(all)
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "opened.json"), b, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
